# The hint script (hints roadmap H2): one step at a time, in order. {action}
# shows that action's keys as bound now; \n breaks a line. Enter skips a step.
# The beam only mines in flight mode, so Tab comes before mining.
hint "PRESS {weapon4} OR {cycleWeapon}\nFOR THE BEAM" hud weapon4 until selected 4
hint "THE BEAM ONLY MINES IN FLIGHT MODE\nPRESS {mode} FOR FLIGHT" hud mode until mode flight
hint "HOLD {fire} ON A ROCK TO MINE IT\nTHE ORE FLIES TO YOU" hud haul until hold 1
hint "FLIGHT IS FAST, BUT HAS NO SHIELD\nPRESS {mode} FOR FIGHT BEFORE A FIGHT" hud mode until mode fight
hint "FLY WITH {forward} {left} {back} {right}\nHOLD {brake} TO BRAKE. HEAD FOR THE GAP" at -12375 -1350 ring 650 until near -12375 -1350 900
hint "HOLD {map} FOR THE WHOLE MAP" until pressed map
hint "THE CIRCLE IS CLOSING ON THIS WAY\nGET INSIDE BEFORE IT DOES, OR BURN" at 6000 1000 until near 6000 1000 13000
hint "AN ENEMY. {cloak} CLOAKS YOU:\nUNSEEN, BUT YOU DRIFT" at -1800 -1300 ring 800 until cloaked
hint "{weapon1} {weapon2} {weapon3} {weapon4} PICK A WEAPON\nHOLD {fire} TO SHOOT. KILL ONE" hud weapon1 until kills 1
hint "HOLD {ram} TO AIM THE RAM\nLET GO TO STRIKE" hud ram until pressed ram
hint "HOLD {scope} TO SEE FAR AHEAD" until pressed scope
hint "THE GATE OPENS ON THE LAST RING\nHOVER IN IT TO LEAVE WITH YOUR ORE" at 14500 1500 ring 1500 until near 14500 1500 1500
hint "BANK YOUR ORE: FLY INTO THE GATE\nWHEN IT GLOWS GOLD" hud haul until seconds 8
